name: SpinningText
description: Text laid out round a circle that turns slowly. The layout is plain CSS (each letter is rotated about the centre), and the real text is in a visually hidden copy.

children.description: The text to set on the circle. A trailing separator such as a dot reads well when the text is shorter than the ring.

radius.description: Radius of the circle in pixels, measured to the middle of the letters.

isPaused.description: Stops the animation and shows the finished text. Moving content that lasts more than five seconds should be stoppable.

requirements: The full text is in a visually hidden copy; the letters on the ring are hidden from assistive technology so nothing is read letter by letter
The ring is a fixed square of 2 x radius plus the letter size, so the page does not shift as it turns
With isPaused the ring stays at its resting angle and the text is still fully readable
Decoration only: the animated layers are hidden from assistive technology and never take focus
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), and can also be shown still with the rdm-still class or isPaused
In forced-colors (high contrast) mode the text is drawn in the system colours with no effect
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
The text is real text in the server HTML, readable with no script
Optional: it is a separate component, so projects that do not add it carry none of its code

use_when: A badge or seal round an icon or logo
A decorative label that links to nothing
avoid_when: Long sentences: letters on a tight circle are hard to read
Any text people must read quickly or act on
Right-to-left or joined scripts, where cutting the text into letters breaks the shapes
anti_patterns: Using it as the only place a link or instruction appears
A radius so small that letters overlap
